scene_description: A woman with long hair stands at an airport observation area, holding a handbag and standing next to a rolling suitcase. She is looking up at a large airplane flying in the sky above her.

questions.question: What is flying up in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up at the top right corner of the picture.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the woman's body — which way is she facing and what is she doing?

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big windows and the airplane — what kind of place has airplanes?

questions.question: What is the woman carrying with her?
questions.evidence_hint: Look next to the woman's feet and in her hand.

questions.question: What might the woman do next with her suitcase?
questions.evidence_hint: She has a suitcase and she is at the airport — think about what people do there.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane or at an airport?
optional_extension_questions.sentence_frame: I have ___ been on an airplane.
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled somewhere far away.
